Twin joysticks fold out from chair arms; AI registers their neutral position
Registered Master's license permits Ada to override flight control when a barge string is attached
Normal safety limits restrict acceleration to keep within gravity and inertial-system capability; pilot can override in an emergency
facts.notes: Available thrust exceeds Sterra's Gift's, but unrestricted operation is difficult to control. Ada's boast about earlier flying is not a measured FF718 speed test.

facts.value: Three barge tongues, each three meters wide and one meter tall, slide into tug receptacles; green indicators show seating
facts.notes: Tongue dimensions describe the attached barge interface, not overall tug dimensions.

facts.value: Physical rocker switch operates dead-head stowage/replacement; its state serves as a visual unloaded reminder
Separate communication, power and hydraulic couplings must connect before flight with tongues attached; lower indicators change from yellow to green
Six-day trip to Precast with fifteen percent fuel reserve, approximately Rate 1 consumption rather than usual economical Rate 4
facts.notes: Two days accelerating and four decelerating; this is a specific loaded route, not a maximum range specification.

facts.value: Large barge mass prevents quick direction changes or evasive dodging
Rotates the entire loaded string for deceleration because the far barge coupling was destroyed in the pirate attack
Has a clean hot shower and a suit freshener; quality prepared food stocked aboard
facts.notes: A cleaning bot is only Liam's speculation, not confirmed equipment.

facts.value: Cockpit rotates around the ladder opening, allowing orientation toward the direction of travel during deceleration
Operator-license coursework is available through the freighter's systems
facts.notes: A paid course service, not a flight capability.

facts.value: Completes Baux-201's three-barge ore delivery to Precast's orbital refinery, then disconnects the string
facts.notes: Preserves Baux family's delivery arrangement; it does not merge the two ship identities.

facts.value: Docks in Chen family's time-share slip at Puskar Stellar orbital station
facts.notes: Slip is 2.4 kilometers from the elevator; not owned by Loose Nuts.

facts.value: Arrives at Jeratorn with an empty three-barge string under escort by Sterra's Gift
Jordy Kelti transfers aboard as second crew/security support
During flight, energy from acceleration feeds the barges' gravity systems to hold their ore loads down
Oxygen crystals approximately twenty percent depleted; topping up is deferred because of high prices
Completes refueling and moves to assigned berth several places from Sterra's Gift
Collects the loaded three-barge ore string at Jeratorn co-op

facts.notes: Three barges carrying about 2,500 tonnes each. This is the voyage's load, not a maximum rated tug capacity.

facts.value: Ada and Jordy wait at the rally point rather than immediately returning to Mars
Supplies hull-patch material and Ada's labor to repair Sterra's Gift
Nick James transfers aboard before Sterra's Gift's final attack
Intervenes at high speed as one dart explodes, spins rapidly and diverts the remaining dart into Sterra's Gift's turret fire
facts.notes: Scene strongly implies Adela Chen causes the first dart's destruction, but neither the weapon nor the exact mechanism is named. No missile launcher or gun model is inferred.

facts.value: Docks to the captured unnamed frigate and carries Liam, Ada, Marny and Tali back toward Jeratorn
Four people fit temporarily in the two-seat cockpit, with Marny and Tali sitting with legs down the ladder opening
facts.notes: Improvised occupancy, not four installed seats or a certified crew capacity.

facts.value: Ada pilots the tug to a short-term ledge/pier on Tower B
Ada hails Flark's escaping runabout and threatens to fire; it returns to the docking bay
facts.notes: No shot or specific mounted weapon is described in this interception.

facts.value: Matches Sterra's Gift's tumble, catches the longer cutter on its frame, arrests both ships' spin and pushes the wreck onto an ore barge
Shorter than Sterra's Gift
facts.notes: No exact overall length supplied.

facts.value: Ada says it can carry both Sterra's Gift's wreck and the captured frigate in addition to the loaded barges
facts.notes: Crew's capability assessment; not a tested maximum tonnage rating.

facts.value: Operational with Ada at the helm; intended to move the prize frigate onto the ore barges for the return to Mars
facts.notes: Wreck recovery is completed; frigate loading and arrival at Mars are still prospective at the end.

facts.value: Fires a volley of bright yellow blaster bolts at Sterra's Gift during the pre-capture encounter
facts.notes: Weapon count, mounting location, and model are not stated.

labelProvenance.rationale: Encounter label for the CA-08 cutter attacking Baux-201; not owned by Baux or the Chen family.

facts.value: Unregistered
Cutter supporting the pirate attack on Baux-201; waits several kilometers behind the attacking darts
Attempts to escape perpendicular to Sterra's Gift's approach

facts.notes: The darts piggybacked on this cutter. Do not infer a permanent certified hangar capacity.

facts.value: Missile strike vaporizes the top third, opens interior to vacuum, and leaves the cutter tumbling
facts.notes: Liam believes the shock killed everyone aboard; casualties are not independently confirmed.

facts.value: Expected to pass near Mars in a few months; possible future salvage, not a completed salvage operation

labelProvenance.rationale: Identifies Celina's use of the cutter left with her; not an assertion of legal title. Earlier-book facts remain pending backfill. Saved Book 02 evidence already distinguishes it from Sterra's Gift.

facts.value: Celina, also called Lena, used the cutter left with her to locate and rescue her sister Jenny with Tali, Jordy, and Ben's help
facts.notes: Book 03 retrospective evidence only. Earlier-book unnamed-vessel facts require a separate authorized backfill; this is not a second Sterra's Gift.

labelProvenance.rationale: Uses the named captain, Vilstrup, to distinguish this hostile frigate from Banny Hill. Possessive indicates command, not legal ownership.

facts.value: Frigate arriving with the giant hauler
Russian-made
facts.notes: No specific builder or model is named.

facts.value: Vilstrup
Liam regards it as Flark's ship
facts.notes: Liam explicitly calls this his opinion; not independently established legal ownership.

facts.value: Escort for the Red Houzi asteroid-theft operation
facts.notes: Affiliation and role, not a proven corporate title of ownership.

facts.value: Connects to Jeratorn by a retracting pressurized catwalk and airlock
Fires on Jeratorn's concourse and docking bays during Sterra's Gift's escape
Deploys countermeasures that intercept both incoming missiles approximately fifty meters short
Designed for broadside fighting rather than hit-and-run tactics
Aft sector is less heavily armored and armed than the broadside; a close stern blind spot remains
facts.notes: Has some stern fire capability; not wholly unarmed astern. Rear armor still withstands Sterra's Gift's blaster fire.
One is hit and two remain operational, establishing three in this scene.

facts.value: One missile penetrates countermeasures and explodes at the engines; two remain operational
facts.notes: Subsequent maneuvering and pursuit capability are impaired.

facts.value: Downward-pointing triangular side profile; fifth deck occupies the narrow bottom
Tali estimates no more than half of the full 42-person complement
facts.notes: Pre-boarding estimate, not a census; separately preserve the prisoner's later 20–25 estimate.
Prisoner explicitly says he is not sure. Attributed estimate, not verified total.

facts.value: Deck two houses bridge and command
Elevator links decks; maintenance shaft runs from deck five to deck one
facts.notes: A stairway also connects onward toward command.

facts.value: Approximately thirty meters, inferred from twenty meters being two-thirds of its height
facts.notes: Narrator's approximate geometry; not an overall vessel height.

facts.value: Large storage room off the upper maintenance-shaft exit, with crates
Infirmary on deck three
Possible sensor strip tracks boarders outside the hull
facts.notes: Liam infers tracking from the defenders' knowledge of his position.

facts.value: Sterra's Gift rams the engine housing and lodges in the stern
Boarders detonate external engine charges to prevent restart; blast releases Sterra's Gift's wreck
Boarders blow the elevator exterior door and fight through internal access routes
facts.notes: Multiple local explosive breaches; extent of all structural damage is not quantified.

facts.value: Vilstrup surrenders in exchange for passage for himself and two others toward the hauler

facts.notes: Eight initially captured and two found during the sweep. Separate from three released officers and earlier combat casualties; do not infer a total initial crew.

facts.value: Nick joins the captured ship to help with prisoners; Jordy remains aboard
Mars Protectorate awards the captured frigate to the privateers
facts.notes: No canonical name is supplied in this book.

facts.value: Plan to lay the disabled frigate sideways on ore barges and return to Mars under Adela Chen's propulsion
facts.notes: Planned, not completed within the book.

facts.value: Marny says one broadside could still be used if it is laid sideways on an ore barge
facts.notes: Conditional assessment, not a completed firing test.

facts.value: Nick expects the damaged frigate to be worth more than Sterra's Gift to the right buyer
facts.notes: Qualitative estimate; no sale or exact price established.

labelProvenance.rationale: Faction-plus-type label grounded in the asteroid theft; exact legal owner or company is not named.

facts.value: Arrives at Jeratorn with a frigate
Flark links procuring the asteroid-moving ship to fifty million in stolen funds and a deal on refinery-grade ore
facts.notes: Attributed claim. Not a verified purchase price, mass rating, or legal ownership document.

facts.value: Massive hauler dominated by enormous engines
facts.notes: Liam speculates about sizeable quarters and multiple bridges but cannot see them; those are not confirmed facilities.

facts.value: Red Houzi asteroid-theft operation
facts.notes: The label identifies operational affiliation; exact legal owner and company are not established.

facts.value: Pushes the co-op's asteroid under slow acceleration while its frigate escort trails behind
facts.notes: Exact attachment mechanism and asteroid mass are not specified.
Four launch in this encounter; no permanent maximum carrier capacity or model is stated.

facts.value: Liam reports it is out of darts after all four are defeated
Liam expects its remaining defense to be stationary heavy blasters
facts.notes: His tactical assessment, not an inspected weapon inventory.

facts.value: Receives three released senior personnel from the captured frigate
Still within enhanced visual range, under attack from a flotilla of small ships
facts.notes: At this point Liam expects eventual destruction but does not observe it. Later naval testimony records the pirates pleading to be taken into custody.

facts.value: Commander Sterra reports that miners hit the hauler with more than a dozen fully loaded ore containers; the pirates begged the arriving Navy to take them into custody
facts.notes: The report calls the target a barge in the reply; context identifies the asteroid-stealing hauler. Do not infer destruction, an ownership award, or completed return of the asteroid.
